description: A stylesheet that defines CSS variables for theming and styling the user interface of a Tic Tac Toe application, including light and dark themes.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the application, styles for text alignment, background color, and animation.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styles for the application logo including size and pointer events.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the header of the application, including layout and background color.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for application links with color transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the button that toggles between light and dark themes, including hover and active states.
